units.note: Not in the listed error classes, so no finding: ὁ λεγόμενος λιμόψωρος is 'hunger-mange' (ψώρα), rendered 'scurvy'; ch. 88 renders the same condition (ψώρα) as 'mange'. Editor may wish to look.

findings.quote: he encamped near the place called Vibo
findings.problem: Greek has τὸ καλούμενον Οἰβώνιον (Oebonium/Vibinum in Daunia, in Apulia). 'Vibo' reads as Vibo Valentia in Bruttium, a different place far to the south.
findings.proposed_fix: he encamped near the place called Oebonium

units.note: Ch. ends mid-word (περὶ πεντήκοντα στα...); 'fifty stades' is the obvious completion, not a defect.
